thread_title: Find a post from the last 3 days: Vitamin D for office workers in India: should I get tested before taking anything?
thread_summary: Look for someone with an indoor job asking if they need vitamin D, how much, or whether to test.
text: Many Indians who work indoors do have low vitamin D, even in a sunny country, because of clothing, pollution and office hours. The sensible order is to get a blood test (25-OH vitamin D) first, then decide with a doctor, since the right dose depends on the result. Ten to fifteen minutes of midday sun on arms and legs a few days a week also helps. Avoid big random doses without a test.
why: D3 is in Mornings at 100% RDA. A test-first answer keeps us honest and avoids deficiency claims.
